start.card:
This shirt costs $100. On Monday the store raises the price by 25%. On Tuesday it lowers the price by 25%.
Is the shirt back to $100? Make a guess first.
start.title: Up 25%, down 25%: back to $100?

afterGuess.card:
Good. Now let the store change the price, one day at a time.
Press "Monday: raise 25%".
afterGuess.title: Up 25%, down 25%: back to $100?

after.card:
You guessed lower than $100, and that is right. The shirt ends at $75, which is $25 less than $100.
Try other percents with the slider. A bigger percent loses more.
after.title: Up 25%, down 25%: back to $100?
